import time
from threading import Lock
from collections import OrderedDict

class ResponseCache:
    """In-process TTL cache for GET /orders/{id} and GET /catalog/* responses."""

    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int = 300, max_size: int = 1000):
        self._ttl = ttl_seconds
        self._max_size = max_size
        self._store: OrderedDict[str, tuple[float, bytes]] = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = Lock()

    def get(self, key: str) -> bytes | None:
        with self._lock:
            item = self._store.get(key)
            if item is None:
                return None
            ts, value = item
            if time.monotonic() - ts > self._ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                return None
            # Move to end to mark as recently used
            self._store.move_to_end(key, last=True)
            return value

    def set(self, key: str, value: bytes) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store[key] = (time.monotonic(), value)
            self._store.move_to_end(key, last=True)
            # Evict oldest entries if over max size
            while len(self._store) > self._max_size:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

import time
from threading import Lock
from collections import OrderedDict

class ResponseCache:
    """In-process TTL cache for GET /orders/{id} and GET /catalog/* responses."""

    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int = 300, max_size: int = 1000):
        self._ttl = ttl_seconds
        self._max_size = max_size
        self._store: OrderedDict[str, tuple[float, bytes]] = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = Lock()

    def get(self, key: str) -> bytes | None:
        with self._lock:
            item = self._store.get(key)
            if item is None:
                return None
            ts, value = item
            if time.monotonic() - ts > self._ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                return None
            # Move to end to mark as recently used
            self._store.move_to_end(key, last=True)
            return value

    def set(self, key: str, value: bytes) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                # Update existing entry and move to end
                self._store.move_to_end(key, last=True)
            elif len(self._store) >= self._max_size:
                # Remove the least recently used item
                self._store.popitem(last=False)
            self._store[key] = (time.monotonic(), value)

    def clean_up(self):
        """Manually clean up expired items."""
        with self._lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            for key in list(self._store.keys()):
                if now - self._store[key][0] > self._ttl:
                    del self._store[key]

import time
import threading
from typing import Optional


class ResponseCache:
    """In-process TTL cache with bounded size."""

    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int = 300, max_items: int = 10000):
        self._ttl = ttl_seconds
        self._max_items = max_items
        self._store: dict[str, tuple[float, bytes]] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._cleanup_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._background_cleanup, daemon=True)
        self._cleanup_thread.start()

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
        with self._lock:
            item = self._store.get(key)
            if item is None:
                return None
            ts, value = item
            if time.monotonic() - ts > self._ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                return None
            return value

    def set(self, key: str, value: bytes) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store[key] = (time.monotonic(), value)
            # Evict LRU when over capacity
            if len(self._store) > self._max_items:
                self._evict_lru()

    def _evict_lru(self) -> None:
        """Remove the least recently used (oldest) item."""
        with self._lock:
            if not self._store:
                return
            # Sort by timestamp (ascending) and remove the first item
            lru_key = min(self._store, key=lambda k: self._store[k][0])
            del self._store[lru_key]

    def _background_cleanup(self) -> None:
        """Periodically evict expired items in a background thread."""
        while True:
            with self._lock:
                now = time.monotonic()
                expired_keys = [k for k, (ts, _) in self._store.items() if now - ts > self._ttl]
                for k in expired_keys:
                    del self._store[k]
            time.sleep(300)  # Run every 5 minutes
